payout.source: R: no original fishing payout table was recovered. The client result reader 00b66be0 carries name, icon, weight, size grade, time, difficulty, rarity and score, and no coin or XP field; the catch reaches the inventory as an ordinary item update. These rows reproduce the previous reconstructed server policy: zero coins and 10 Fisherman XP per catch. Per-grade rows are the tunable table; values are not original balance.

catch_cap.source: R: no original fishing cap was recovered. The client sends no catch outcome and the server owns selection and payout, so a cap is an operator policy. It is disabled by default; the owner chooses the value. A session cap counts paid catches across trips until the login session resets. An hour cap counts paid catches in a rolling 3600-second window keyed by character, so reconnecting does not refresh it; the server keeps that ledger for its process lifetime until save-schema persistence is approved.
